recommendation_text: Longs earn because equity indexes drift up. The 20d-positive filter does not create a standalone Strategy #3 versus simply being long RTH. Do not freeze. Do not reopen two-sided TSMOM. Do not add shorts.

spec.forbidden: No shorts, no Phase 40/42 retrofit, no VWAP, no DVP 15m drift, no RSI/MACD/ADX, no holdout tuning, no freeze, no cash/ETF substitutes.
spec.thesis: BULLISH STATE -> LONG; NON-BULLISH STATE -> FLAT. Never BEARISH -> SHORT.

distinct_from.phase40: Two-sided TSMOM closed. Phase 44 is a new long-only state model, not TSMOM minus shorts.
distinct_from.phase42: HTF 1h pullback closed. Phase 44 state is prior-session multi-day, not completed 1h return.
distinct_from.dvp: No VWAP, no 15m hour-return drift, no 80-pt stop. Prior-session 20d state only.

spec.signal_series: Databento ohlcv-1d .v.0. Lookback uses roll-cleaned close-to-close (Phase 40 mark_rolls: instrument_id sidecar else 8x median overnight AND 80 bps). Sunday Globex stubs dropped.
spec.state_at: Completed prior session. Current RTH cannot see today's unfinished daily bar.

primary_state.rule: 20-session roll-cleaned return ending at prior completed close > 0 => BULLISH next session, else FLAT.

primary_intraday_baseline.rules: If prior 20d > 0, buy next RTH 09:30 open +/- 1 tick, flatten 15:55. Long only.

primary_intraday_candidate.rules: Prior 20d > 0. First completed red 5m after 09:30, then first completed green 5m. Enter next 5m open +/- 1 tick. Stop = pullback low - 1 tick. 1R tracked independently. No new entry after 15:00. Flatten 15:55. Max 1/day. Never short.
primary_intraday_candidate.reason: Locked before Phase 44 P&L. Pullback is not a rescue if the open-long baseline is negative.

mode2.note: Diagnostic overnight. Not the prop primary.

spec.always_long_benchmark: Required. If the filter does not improve return/risk vs buying every RTH, status is LONG_DRIFT_BETA_ONLY.
spec.note: Phase 44 does not freeze. Candidate JSON only if LONG_ONLY_EDGE_FOUND.

meta.volume_semantics: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m volume = total trade volume aggregated over the 1m interval (CME MDP 3.0 electronic session trades). Units: contract lots traded. May differ from official venue settlement volumes that include block/OTC.

gc.note: Phase 26 paper journal is empty until forward paper trades exist.

news.note: CPI/NFP 08:30 +/- 5m never overlaps RTH 09:30 or later 5m entries. No complete 10:00 calendar applied.

bear.note: Long-only must turn off in deteriorated 20d states. 2022 share is the off-switch test.
